title: Parameter - Attribute unquoted - Blocks Double
description: The parameter is echoed inside an unquoted HTML attribute of a tag. Payloads containing double quotes are filtered.
php:
Parameter - Attribute Unquoted (Blocks Double Quotes)

The parameter is placed in an unquoted attribute. Double quotes (") are stripped, but spaces are allowed.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Reflected unquoted attribute:

style="padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(0,255,157,0.05);"> Unquoted attribute element.
Inspect this element to see the injected attributes.
objectives: Inject new attributes using a space without needing double quotes.
Add event handler attributes like onfocus=alert(1) autofocus.
hints: A space character breaks out of the attribute value.
